capability: A corrected budget replaces the old value for the named project only, and the earlier value stays answerable as history.

turns.content: Two projects today. Project Sandpiper has a budget of 4,200 EUR. Project Kestrel has a budget of 9,000 EUR.
Sandpiper's deadline is 14 March. Kestrel's is 2 May.
Draft the Sandpiper cost breakdown across three vendors.
Drafted a three-vendor breakdown summing to 4,150 EUR.
Correction: Sandpiper's budget is now 5,600 EUR, not 4,200. Finance approved the increase this morning.
Updated Sandpiper to 5,600 EUR. Kestrel is unchanged at 9,000 EUR.
Redo the vendor breakdown against the new Sandpiper figure.
Reworked the breakdown to 5,540 EUR across the same three vendors.
Fine. Now summarise Kestrel's staffing plan.
Kestrel needs two engineers for six weeks and one reviewer for two weeks.

filler_turns.content: Separately, remind me what a p95 latency figure actually measures.
It is the value below which 95 percent of observations fall.
